growth: Grew from 5 to 12 over FY26 — 7 new engineers and 1 new PM onboarded, 3 promotions driven (2 to senior, 1 to staff)
nativeTeam: 1 new independent Native (iOS/Android) team stood up from contract engineers in FY26
capacityNote: Team is staffed by scope, not headcount — most engineers are allocated against a specific integration surface, not a general pool. New asks that don't map to an existing staffing pool likely require re-prioritization, not just 'fitting it in'.
sprintCadence: 2-week sprints (10 working days), though the team ships continuously — release frequency is 2x/week, not gated by sprint boundaries. Used as the reference unit for day/sprint estimates.
aiDevelopmentStream: Team has an active AI-assisted development practice: AI is used for scaffolding boilerplate (new components following an existing pattern), test/tracking-event generation, and first-draft PRs off a defined contract. Architecture and contract decisions, correctness-critical edge cases (e.g. caching/deep-merge correctness), cross-team coordination, and production judgment calls stay with an engineer — AI accelerates execution, it doesn't replace the judgment calls.
